newsitem.title: USA: Franklin says president to resign.
newsitem.headline: Franklin says president to resign.

text.p: Franklin Electronic Publishers Inc said Wednesday that Morton David will fill the post of president for an interim period since William Turner its current president resigned to accepted another offer.
Turner, Franklin Electronics' current president and co-chief executive officer, has accepted an offer to become president and chief executive of PNC Bank New Jersey, effective August 1.
David is currently Franklin's chairman and co-CEO.
Franklin Electronic manufactures and distributes hand held electronic books.
